scope.remoteActions: Read only four source dependencies via cloud.py; no source writes or test processes.
scope.writes: This JSON and reviewer-source snapshots only; no source/IMPL edits.

priorFindings.fix: Negative model calls pass verify=false and return immediately after inspectRuntime. Capacity tests independently assert observed.mutations==0, so protocol or model failure after approvals cannot satisfy the preflight check.
priorFindings.bounds: No tests or mutation trials were executed by this reviewer. Fault-call assertions remain legitimate constraints on encoded recipient/amount.

priorFindings.fix: New compatibility suite covers Aqua omitted/executor/external receiver forwarding and invalid recipients; UniV2 CP same quote bytes for external receivers, opaque omitted/explicit executor acceptance, external quote rejection, invalid receiver rejection. Explicit synthetic opaque descriptor was added after the saved corpus was found to contain only CP.
priorFindings.bounds: Synthetic opaque descriptor is emitter-only evidence, never a Ready or admission claim. Compatibility suite execution results were not reviewed here.

productionCodeReview.result: No new payer debit, recipient credit, fee, reserve/capacity, opcode or default-path defect found.
checks: PSV static preview is bound to actual recipient; gross reserve net+fee is separate from receiver net+fee*treasuryAlias.
Zero-disabled txn cap effective MAX addition cannot overflow: the MAX term is nonzero only for cap=0. Remaining capacity, amount and net positivity are checked.

Nested child programs preserve parent r0; input approval and swap use the full invocation input. Direct verifies exact payer debit and receiver credit; local separate-recipient old-input/old-output checks reject payer treasury fee residue.
Default PSV swap/quoted program construction remains equivalent; default Exact and evidence/cache contracts remain unchanged. Existing historical default evidence is not invalidated.
Generic quote receiver matches actual prefix receiver; Aqua and UniV2 retain existing valid self-recipient paths. Opaque external quote correctly refuses unsupported output/payment callback coupling.
math eq kind7 is consistent across Solidity, emitter and interpreter; previous checked math, signed neg restriction, assert-equal and read-only semantics are retained.

evmHarnessReview.type: actual saved PSV runtime templates with relocated UUPS __self, fresh local proxy storage and synthetic ERC20 contracts; not historical fee/cap/whitelist state
evmHarnessReview.identityBinding: Solidity pins proxy code hash, patches both implementation __self offsets and installs EIP-1967 slot. The FFI emitter reads the same source-runtime fixture and setup()/identity/proveImplementation checks the normalized implementation template hash and self-address binding before producing a Family program. Fixture token code hashes represent synthetic descriptor setup; this is not live strict admission.
evmHarnessReview.emission: FFI invokes the actual production Family emitter for quote and direct programs. Test contract receives bytecode, not a handwritten substitute program.
positiveChecks: Quote-output executes as a read-only nested program and compares its output to the real deployed-code preview adjusted only for treasury==receiver.

Direct EVM success independently reads payer input debit, unchanged payer old output, unchanged receiver old input, receiver output credit, vault gross output debit, zero final allowance and payer native balance.
Both directions, nonzero fees, payer whitelist vs receiver whitelist, treasury==receiver, zero fee and asymmetric 18/6 and 6/18 decimals are exercised.
negativeChecks: expectRevert applies to bot.execute only. Subsequent direct EVM storage reads assert seven balance positions, preexisting allowance and remaining block capacity are unchanged; these assertions cannot masquerade as the expected transaction revert.
Synthetic token faults allow zero/one-under/one-over debit with no token allowance failure, so deleting the Family exact-debit guard would let those cases execute and fail the expected-revert test.
Short/wrong output, false approval and treasury==payer residue have valid surrounding balances and capture actual Family failure/rollback.

Sequential capped swaps test inclusive transaction/block limits, exhausted block capacity and next-block reset using actual saved PSV code. Gross reserve shortfall, pause and zero/rounded-zero output are represented.
limitations: Success checks use deployed preview as the net/fee oracle; they verify Family agreement with that contract rather than independently proving all protocol fee arithmetic. Offline fixture arithmetic and source review supplement this.
The Solidity EVM suite does not prove static capacity rejection occurs before approval by itself; the revised offline observed.mutations==0 tests cover that distinction.

Receiver native balance and a distinct treasury positive fee delta are not independently asserted by the Solidity success helper; payer native, receiver token balances and vault gross debit are checked.
The reviewer did not execute Forge/FFI or inspect final passing receipts. Initial filesystem-permission failure and retries must remain separate execution records.

historicalHarnessReview.historicalReady: Copies prior Ready to a new logs output, selectively invokes current production rebuild for PSV/V2/V3 at pinned N, verifies unchanged prior-file hash and source-before/after, then invokes production runAtBlock through prices. No manually minted target identity or price amount was found. The result label is stage completion; final effective-row acceptance is enforced by historical-dual productionAmount(status=met).
historicalHarnessReview.historicalDual: Preserves prior default Exact/quoted/runtime tests and adds actual-recipient preview, current-source issued quote/direct and effect-delta execution. Each external recipient uses its own preview and treasury-adjusted expected credit; no default executor quote output is reused as recipient output. Successful observations cover payer, vault, recipient and treasury for both tokens, including alias aggregation.
sourceBinding: Ready hash and current memo definition; N/hash/generation checks; prices source provenance and effective amount; current production source tree; runner and helper hashes; REVM binary hash; every executor artifact Solidity source hash and provisioned runtime code hash; final before/after pin checks.
stateRequests+decodeState recheck proxy, implementation slot/runtime identity, token code/decimals/scales and mutable PSV state at the same pinned source.
controls: No-input negative uses the same execution script/calldata as its positive counterpart and only changes actor input funding to zero.
Post-execution-revert appends a deliberate failing equality, so it is a separate atomicity control with different calldata.
Successful event recipient, input, net amount and fee are independently checked against the recipient preview and observed balance deltas.

strictTransportFacts.success: Checks node source attestation and counterfactual executor code hash; requires exact requested token/native observation cardinality and account order; maps validated successful token deltas/native delta/logs into Family effects.
strictTransportFacts.native: requestSnapshot lines 264-266 requests native balances only for caller/from. No external recipient native observation is produced.
strictTransportFacts.revert: responseSnapshot lines 329-344 requires non-success effects arrays empty and returns empty observations. Nested incomplete/halt provenance is rejected from declared successful evidence. Thus empty tokenDeltas after revert are transport behavior, not an independently observed full zero stateDiff.
strictTransportFacts.rawEvidence: The runner saves central outcome/effects and source pins; its wrapper does not retain raw call trace or full stateDiff.

requiredClaimLimits: Historical positive evidence is same-N-end current-executor receipt/debit observation, not original pre-call TX parity, whole-loop success or performance.
Historical negative evidence is declared EVM revert with unchanged calldata for no-input controls; it is not independent full historical stateDiff rollback.
Historical recipient native is unmeasured. Do not claim it from the caller native delta.
Nonzero fees/caps/whitelist and asymmetric decimals in the added EVM suite are fresh synthetic state on genuine code templates; they are not historical mainnet state.
Actual execution acceptance remains pending until final saved results are inspected.

packageRegistration.reviewed: package.json adds PSV runtime-recipient, historical-ready and historical-dual scripts. The standalone compatibility and Forge invocation still need their actual selected tool-run manifest/receipts to count as executed reconciliation; registration/source text is not execution evidence.
